title: Angles and parallel lines - pilot draft

prompt.en: Two adjacent angles lie on one straight line. The known angle is 98°. Find x in degrees and give a reason.
prompt.zh: 兩個鄰角在同一直線上。已知角為 98°。求 x（度），並給理由。

hint.en: Identify the given relationship before choosing an equality or a total.
hint.zh: 先辨認已知角關係，再選擇相等或角的總和。

solution.en: The stated straight/supplementary angle total is 180°. Hence x=82°.
solution.zh: 已知平角或補角的總和為 180°。所以 x=82°。

reasonRubric.en: Name the applicable given relation and show the equality/subtraction. Numerical correctness alone does not verify this reason.
reasonRubric.zh: 須說明適用的已知角關係，並展示相等或減法；數值正確不代表理由已獲核實。

prompt.en: A transversal t meets l at A and m at B. Direct t from B towards A. P is at A, inside the two-intersection region and on the right of directed t; Q is at B, outside the two-intersection region and on the right of directed t. Name the pair. Parallelism is not given; the sketch is not a premise about equality.
prompt.zh: 截線 t 與 l、m 分別相交於 A、B，t 的方向由 B 指向 A。P 在 A，位於兩交點之間區域的內側，且在有方向的 t 的右方；Q 在 B，位於兩交點之間區域的外側，且在有方向的 t 的右方。辨認角對。未有給定平行；不可從草圖外觀推斷角相等。

hint.en: Use intersection, inside/outside and side of the directed transversal.
hint.zh: 按交點、內外位置及截線的哪一方來辨認。

solution.en: P and Q are corresponding angles. This names their positions; without parallelism it does not establish equality or a 180° sum.
solution.zh: P、Q 是同位角。這只表示位置；未有平行條件，不可因此判定相等或和為 180°。

prompt.en: A transversal t meets l at A and m at B. Direct t from B towards A. P is at A, outside the two-intersection region and on the right of directed t; Q is at B, inside the two-intersection region and on the left of directed t. Given l ∥ m and P=80°, find Q=x and give a reason.
prompt.zh: 截線 t 與 l、m 分別相交於 A、B，t 的方向由 B 指向 A。P 在 A，位於兩交點之間區域的外側，且在有方向的 t 的右方；Q 在 B，位於兩交點之間區域的內側，且在有方向的 t 的左方。已知 l ∥ m，P=80°。求 Q=x，並給理由。

hint.en: Use the stated parallel premise together with the marked pair positions.
hint.zh: 須同時使用已知平行條件及所標示的角對位置。

solution.en: First use the corresponding angle at B, then its adjacent straight-line angle. Thus Q=100°.
solution.zh: 先用 B 的同位角，再用其鄰接平角。所以 Q=100°。

reasonRubric.en: Name l ∥ m, identify the angle pair and any local straight-angle step. Review the written chain separately from the final number.
reasonRubric.zh: 須指出 l ∥ m、角對，以及適用的鄰接平角步驟；書面推理與最終數值分開評閱。

label.en: The data are insufficient to decide
No, the stated angle data rule out parallelism
label.zh: 否，已知角資料排除了平行

prompt.en: A transversal t meets l at A and m at B. Direct t from B towards A. P is at A, inside the two-intersection region and on the right of directed t; Q is at B, inside the two-intersection region and on the right of directed t. P=106° and Q=73°. The marked pair is same-side interior angles. Must l and m be parallel? Explain using only these givens; appearance is not a premise.
prompt.zh: 截線 t 與 l、m 分別相交於 A、B，t 的方向由 B 指向 A。P 在 A，位於兩交點之間區域的內側，且在有方向的 t 的右方；Q 在 B，位於兩交點之間區域的內側，且在有方向的 t 的右方。P=106°，Q=73°。所標示的是同旁內角。l、m 是否必定平行？只用已知條件解釋，不可以外觀作依據。

hint.en: A parallel test needs a relationship linking the two different intersections, not just a local equality at one intersection.
hint.zh: 判定平行須有連起兩個不同交點的角關係，不能只憑同一交點的局部相等。

solution.en: 106+73=179 do not satisfy the 180° same-side interior condition. Therefore l and m cannot be parallel under these givens.
solution.zh: 106+73=179 不符合同旁內角和為 180°的條件，所以在這些已知條件下 l、m 不平行。

reasonRubric.en: Identify the stated relationship and its parallel test, or explain why local vertical equality gives no information about the second line.
reasonRubric.zh: 指出已知角關係和相應的平行判定條件，或解釋為何局部對頂角相等不能提供另一條線的資料。

prompt.en: In triangle ABC, A=74° and B=61°. Find the interior angle C=x. Give a reason.
prompt.zh: 在三角形 ABC，A=74°，B=61°。求內角 C=x。並給理由。

hint.en: Identify whether x is inside the triangle or between AC and the extended ray CD.
hint.zh: 先辨認 x 是三角形內角，還是 AC 與延長射線 CD 之間的外角。

reasonRubric.en: Identify the requested sector and use the triangle interior sum or exterior-angle theorem with the two remote interior angles.
reasonRubric.zh: 指出所求角區域，並使用三角形內角和，或外角等於兩個不相鄰內角之和的定理。

question.answer: p=β; q=γ; p+α+q=180°; E+γ=180°; therefore E=α+β.

prompt.en: In triangle ABC, the constructed line uAv is parallel to BC. The marked angles at A on that line are p and q; the triangle angles are α, β, γ. Use alternate interior and straight angles to prove α+β+γ=180°. Then, with BC extended to D, prove the exterior angle E at C equals α+β.
prompt.zh: 在三角形 ABC，已作 uAv ∥ BC。A 點直線上的兩個標示角為 p、q；三角形內角為 α、β、γ。請用內錯角及平角證明 α+β+γ=180°，再在 BC 延長至 D 時證明 C 的外角 E=α+β。

hint.en: Match p with β and q with γ using the constructed parallel lines. Do not use the triangle-sum theorem to prove itself.
hint.zh: 先利用所作平行線把 p 與 β、q 與 γ 配對；不要用三角形內角和定理來證明它自己。

solution.en: Because uAv ∥ BC, p=β and q=γ by alternate interior angles. Along the straight line at A, p+α+q=180°. Substitute to obtain α+β+γ=180°. Also E+γ=180° along BCD, so E=α+β. This is a deductive proof, not a measurement of this particular drawing.
solution.zh: 因 uAv ∥ BC，內錯角相等，故 p=β、q=γ。在 A 的平角上，p+α+q=180°，代入得 α+β+γ=180°。又因 BCD 為直線，E+γ=180°，所以 E=α+β。這是演繹證明，不是量度某幅圖的結果。

reasonRubric.en: Manual review of the entire proof: cite the constructed parallel premise, match both alternate pairs, use the straight angle at A, and derive the exterior claim using E+γ=180°. Do not accept a numerical answer or circular use of triangle-sum as a proof of the general statement.
reasonRubric.zh: 整份證明需人工評閱：引用所作的平行條件、配對兩組內錯角、使用 A 的平角，再由 E+γ=180° 推出外角結果。單一數值或以內角和定理循環證明本身，不能構成一般命題的證明。
